alt: The program reads numbers in a loop, adding each positive one to a total, skipping negative ones, and stopping when it reads a 0.

steps.c: Python starts at the top of the file. Line 1 runs first.
Line 1 runs: `total` is created with the value `0`. Line 2, `while True:`, needs no check, so the loop body starts at line 3.
Line 3 runs: `n` is created with the value `4`.
Line 4 checks the condition: it is false, so line 6 runs next.
Line 6 checks the condition: it is false, so line 8 runs next.
Line 8 runs: `total` changes from `0` to `4`. The loop goes back to the top for its next pass, so line 3 runs next.
Line 3 runs: `n` changes from `4` to `6`.
Line 4 checks the condition: it is false, so line 6 runs next.
Line 6 checks the condition: it is false, so line 8 runs next.
Line 8 runs: `total` changes from `4` to `10`. The loop goes back to the top for its next pass, so line 3 runs next.
Line 3 runs: `n` changes from `6` to `0`.
Line 4 checks the condition: it is true, so line 5 runs next.
Line 5 runs; line 9 is next. Reading `0` reaches this `break`, which exits the loop immediately, skipping every line below it.
Line 9 runs: it prints `10`. The program has finished: no lines are left to run.
